answers:
You need to build the library and publish the build result as an npm package. From the docs:

Use the Angular CLI and the npm package manager to build and publish your library as an npm package.

ng build my-lib
cd dist/my-lib
npm publish

Installing your library via git repository does not work, because this is just the source code for the library, but you need a built library.

nuggets.text: The library must be built using the Angular CLI to generate the compiled output.
The compiled library should be published as an npm package.
Installing the library directly from a git repository is insufficient because it only provides the source code, not the compiled library.
